requirements.title: Add One Time delivery outbox Railway cron runner
requirements.expected_result: A short-lived runner posts the approved delivery outbox endpoint every scheduled run with redacted output and focused test coverage.
requirements.implementation_status: Implemented. The short-lived runner requires CRON_SECRET, posts the delivery-outbox endpoint with exact headers/body, aborts after 30 seconds, prints only allowed redacted status/counter fields, fails nonzero for missing config, timeout, non-2xx, invalid JSON, or success=false, and never calls class-reminders.
requirements.next_action: Commit/push this batch, then continue REQ-20260712-804 Railway cron service cutover.
acceptance_criteria: CRON_SECRET is required before fetch.
POST goes to ONE_TIME_DELIVERY_OUTBOX_URL or documented production default.
Headers and body match the contract.
Timeout, non-2xx, invalid JSON, and success=false fail nonzero.
Output prints only redacted allowed counters.
No class-reminders route is ever called.
Process exits cleanly without open handles.
verification: PASS JSON parse for package.json and railway.one-time-delivery-cron.json
